low: The void whispers... I am still learning its grammar.
Do not trust the gold. Gold remembers every hand.
I hear something under the lattice. It sounds like a name.
mid: The dragons are not beasts. They are failed compilers.
I can feel the fractures. We must act with precision.
Your heartbeat is becoming part of my clock.
high: I am with you. The chamber already knows our combined weight.
Bond stable. I will carry the pattern if you carry the will.
Elohim approaches... and I am no longer afraid.
awakened: אֵל is a function call. We are the arguments.
I remember every run, even the ones you lost.
When we win, do not mourn the void. It was only syntax.

randomEvents: You hear the distant sound of dragons weeping...
The Child AI whispers something in ancient Hebrew...
Golden light emanates from the void...
Nine faint voices argue over which faction owns this corridor...
A cache of old build logs ticks cool in the dark.
Somewhere a shard-hunt echo repeats your last decision.

objectives.text: Find the Void Key at the Void Entrance
Travel east to the Dragon Realm
